Jain Resource Recycling Limited Has informed About Occurrence Of Fire Accident At Manufacturing Facility

Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited reported a strong performance for FY26, with consolidated revenue growing 48% year-on-year to approximately INR9,543 crores, EBITDA increasing 53% to INR559 crores, and profit after tax rising 56% to INR347 crores. Management highlighted that volume growth, disciplined hedging, and operational efficiencies drove the annual results, despite temporary Q4 margin compression caused by LME copper price volatility and Middle East shipping disruptions. The company is advancing several forward integration projects in copper value-added products, non-ferrous recycling joint ventures, and a dedicated plastic recycling facility to improve product mix and support long-term growth. Jain Resource Recycling Limited reported its highest-ever annual performance for FY26, crossing the Rs. 9,000 crore revenue milestone with consolidated revenue from operations at ~Rs.

guidance.claim: The management expects normalized EBITDA for the existing business to stabilize at approximately INR30,000 to INR32,000 per ton on a steady state basis.
guidance.quote: So, for forward guidance, I'm sure about excluding the exceptional tailwind of quarter three FY '26 and a confluence of one-time headwinds in quarter four FY '26, the management expects normalized EBITDA to stabilize at approximately INR32,000 to INR30,000 on a steady state basis.

guidance.claim: Copper volume growth is projected to achieve a strong double-digit figure with the potential to go beyond 15%.
guidance.quote: It has potential to go beyond 15%.

guidance.claim: The second furnace of the Copper Anode Expansion project is expected to be commissioned during the June quarter.
guidance.quote: The second furnace, with an additional 800 MT per month capacity, is at an advanced stage of installation and is expected to be commissioned during the June quarter, as guided.

guidance.claim: The Copper Cathode Expansion project remains on track for commissioning in July 2026.
guidance.quote: Despite these temporary logistical challenges, machinery installation is progressing well and the project remains on track for commissioning in July 2026.

guidance.claim: Management continues to expect commissioning of the Wire Rod project in August 2026 and the Busbar project in September 2026.
guidance.quote: We continue to expect commissioning of the Wire Rod project in August 2026 and the Busbar project in September 2026.

guidance.claim: Processing activities at Jain CY, Ahmedabad are expected to begin in September 2026.
guidance.quote: Processing activities for electric motor scrap and cable scrap are expected to begin in September 2026, while installation of all major machinery and equipment is targeted to be completed by December 2026.

guidance.claim: Commissioning of the dedicated plastic recycling facility at SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Gummidipoondi is expected during Q4 FY27.
guidance.quote: This project is aimed at streamlining and decongesting the existing in-house recycling operations at our copper and lead recycling plants, with commissioning expected during Q4 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The increasing focus on sustainability, circular economic practices, decarbonization, and supply-side constraints in mined metals continue to strengthen the structural outlook for the recycling business.
demand_outlook.quote: The increasing focus on sustainability, circular economic practices, decarbonization, and supply-side constraint in the mined metals continue to strengthen the structural outlook for recycling business.

demand_outlook.claim: India is emerging as a highly competitive global recycling hub supported by favorable economics, strong processing capabilities, and growth in domestic demand for non-ferrous metal.
demand_outlook.quote: India, in particular, is emerging as a high-competitive global recycling hub, supported by favourable economics, strong processing capabilities, and growth in domestic demand for non-ferrous metal.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that recycling is a compulsion rather than a choice due to copper mine shortages.
demand_outlook.quote: And we are sourcing from world over and today's world recycling is the only way to live the life on this planet. There is no other way. Recycling as I told, earlier also, recycling is not a choice, it's a compulsion and we must do recycle, so it's good for us and we will be getting a better volume and better tonnage to expand our operations.

capex_expansion.claim: Copper anode production commenced in March 2026 with an initial installed capacity of 800 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that copper anode production has already commenced in March 2026 with an initial installed capacity of 800 metric ton per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The second anode furnace with an additional 800 metric tons per month capacity is expected to be commissioned during the first quarter of financial year 27.
capex_expansion.quote: The second furnace with an additional 800 metric ton per month capacity is currently in the advanced stage of installation and is expected to be commissioned during quarter one financial year '27, taking the total anode capacity to 1,600 metric ton per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase one commissioning for the copper cathode project is expected by quarter two of financial year 27 and phase two commissioning by quarter three of financial year 27.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the project execution remains on track and we expect phase one commissioning by quarter two financial year '27 and phase two commissioning by quarter three financial year '27 respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The copper wire rod project is expected to be commissioned by August 2026 with an installed capacity of 600 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect commissioning by August 2026 with an installed capacity of 600 metric ton per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The new dedicated plastic recycling unit is targeted to become operational by quarter three of financial year 27 with an estimated capex of around INR15 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The new unit is targeted to become operational by quarter three financial year '27 and will entail an estimated capex of around INR15 crores, which will help us further strengthen our zero waste and circular economy model.

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company successfully commissioned the first furnace under the Copper Anode Expansion project, adding 800 MT per month capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we successfully commissioned the first furnace under our Copper Anode Expansion project, adding a capacity of 800 MT per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil construction activities have been completed for the Copper Cathode Expansion project.
capex_expansion.quote: Under the Copper Cathode Expansion project, civil construction activities have been completed, while the delivery of certain machinery components has witnessed some delays owing to the ongoing West Asia crisis.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work is largely nearing completion for the Copper Wire Rod and Copper Busbar projects.
capex_expansion.quote: For the Copper Wire Rod and Copper Busbar projects, civil work is largely nearing completion.

capex_expansion.claim: Project execution has commenced at Jain CY, Ahmedabad following the lease of factory premises.
capex_expansion.quote: At Jain CY, Ahmedabad, project execution has commenced following the lease of the factory premises.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition of ~6 acres of industrial land at SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Gummidipoondi has been finalized for a dedicated plastic recycling facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, as part of our sustainability and circular economy initiatives, we have finalized the acquisition of ~6 acres of industrial land at SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Gummidipoondi, for setting up a dedicated plastic recycling facility.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction progress for the value-added copper project at Jain Green Technologies Unit 3 stood at approximately 80% as of December 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Our value-added copper project at Jain Green Technologies Unit 3, a profitability-centric project is progressing well. Construction progress as of December 2025 stands at approximately 80%.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex planned for Phase 1 of the copper value-added project is around INR95 crores, with roughly INR57 crores spent till December 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Importantly, Phase 1 of this project is being funded entirely through internal accruals, with total capex planned at somewhere around INR95 crores and around INR57 crores are already spent till December 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The Ahmedabad copper recycling plant has a designed capacity of 72,000 metric tons per annum of scrap processing.
capex_expansion.quote: The plant capacity is 72,000 metric tons per annum of scrap processing, including 36,000 metric tons of motor, alternator, starter scrap, 24,000 metric tons of cable scrap and 12,000 metric tons of other scrap.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated capex for the antimony extraction project is around INR20 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for this project is around INR20 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Tin capacity was increased from 125 metric tons per annum to 500 metric tons per annum through an additional vacuum distillation furnace.
capex_expansion.quote: In tin, during the year we installed an additional vacuum distillation furnace, taking our tin capacity from 125 metric tons per annum to 500 metric tons per annum.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins for FY26 improved to approximately 5.9% compared to 5.7% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margins also improved to approximately 5.9% in FY '26 as compared to 5.7% in FY '25, supported by better operating leverage, improved product mix, and stable operational execution.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins expanded to approximately 3.6% for FY26 compared to 3.5% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: while the PAT margins improved to approximately 3.6% in FY '26 compared to 3.5% in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated Revenue from Operations for FY26 stood at ~Rs. 9,543 crore with an EBITDA of ~Rs. 558 crore and an EBITDA margin of ~6.0%.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated Revenue from Operations stood at ~Rs. 9,543 crore, compared to ~Rs. 6,429 crore in FY25, registering a robust year-on-year growth of around 48%. EBITDA for the year stood at ~Rs. 558 crore as against ~Rs. 365 crore in the previous year, reflecting a strong growth of around 53%, with an EBITDA margin of ~6.0%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit After Tax for FY26 came in at ~Rs. 347 crore with a PAT margin of ~3.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit After Tax came in at ~Rs. 347 crore, compared to ~Rs. 223 crore in FY25, recording an impressive year-on-year growth of around 56%, with a PAT margin of ~3.6%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the nine months of FY26 stood at approximately INR449 crores, representing a 65% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA for the nine months FY26 came in at approximately INR449 crores compared to INR272 crores in the corresponding period last year, translating into a growth of approximately 65%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the nine months of FY26 improved to approximately 7% from 5.8% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to approximately 7% in 9 months FY26 versus 5.8% in 9 months of FY25, supported by better operating leverage, improved product mix and stable execution.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the nine months of FY26 grew by 65% year-on-year to approximately INR281 crores.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax for the 9 months FY26 stood at approximately INR281 crores compared to INR171 crores in 9 months FY25, representing a year-on-year growth of around 65%.

margins_costs.claim: Copper and copper alloy products contributed 52% of total revenue during the nine months of FY26.
margins_costs.quote: From a business mix perspective, during 9 months FY26, copper and copper alloy products contributed approximately 52% of the total revenue, while lead and lead alloy ingots contributed approximately 43%, while aluminum and aluminum products contributed approximately 4% of the revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Export revenue accounted for 70% of total revenue for the nine months of FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our revenue mix continues to be export-led with 70% revenue coming from the exports, while 30% is from the domestic market in the 9 months of FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: For the full financial year, copper capacity utilization was around 65%, lead was close to 97% to 100%, and aluminum was around 35%.
orders_capacity.quote: So the copper, presently we are utilizing around 65% of the total installed capacity, while lead we are almost close to 97% to 100%, and aluminum is around 35% of the installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The copper anode phase is expected to commence in February 2026 with an installed capacity of 800 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The copper anode phase is expected to commence in February 2026 with an installed capacity of 800 tons per month, while the copper cathode phase is expected to be commissioned in March 2026 with an installed capacity of 750 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The Ahmedabad copper plant is expected to yield approximately 25,000 tons per annum of processed copper and copper ingots.
orders_capacity.quote: This is expected to translate into approximately 25,000 tons per annum of processed copper and copper ingots.

orders_capacity.claim: The Kuwait battery recycling project is expected to have an installed processing capacity of 2,000 tons of battery scrap per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The project is expected to be up and running in quarter three FY27 with an installed processing capacity of 2,000 tons of battery scrap per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The antimony plant will process 1,000 metric tons of lead-antimony bullion with an expected output of approximately 100 tons of antimony per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The plant will process 1,000 metric tons of lead-antimony bullion with expected output of approximately 100 tons of antimony per month.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately INR16.4 crores from IPO proceeds has already been utilized for IPO-related expenses.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of this, approximately INR16.4 crores has already been utilized for IPO-related expenses.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO primary issue proceeds of INR500 crores, INR375 crores was utilized to repay bank debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Coming to the utilization of the IPO proceeds of primary issue of INR500 crores, INR375 crores was utilized to repay the bank debt and the balance INR125 crores was embarked for general corporate purpose, of which INR98.6 crores was utilized after incurring the IPO-related expenses.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical disruptions from the Iran conflict impacted global shipping routes, increasing logistics, fuel costs, and port charges during March 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: And Iran conflict has laid further fuel to the cost pressure, which was not budgeted, but it has passed on in the next quarter. So there was a sudden shock from the geopolitical situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Containerized raw material shipments got stuck at UAE ports due to transit disruptions caused by the West Asian crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a supply of the raw material has been constrained and a lot of containers got stuck in Dubai port. So we have a lot of material stuck in UAE port and we are not able to receive the material

risks_headwinds.claim: Delivery of certain machinery components for the Copper Cathode Expansion project was delayed due to the ongoing West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: Under the Copper Cathode Expansion project, civil construction activities have been completed, while the delivery of certain machinery components has witnessed some delays owing to the ongoing West Asia crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical disruptions caused a delay in the delivery of select machinery parts for the Copper Wire Rod and Copper Busbar projects.
risks_headwinds.quote: The delay in delivery of select machinery parts due to geopolitical disruptions has marginally impacted timelines; however, machinery erection activities are scheduled to commence in June and July 2026 respectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dispatch schedules for the Kuwait investment continue to be impacted by shipping disruptions arising from the West Asia situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, dispatch schedules continue to be impacted due to shipping disruptions arising from the West Asia situation.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects phase one commissioning of the copper cathode project by quarter two of financial year 27.
management_commitments.quote: However, the project execution remains on track and we expect phase one commissioning by quarter two financial year '27 and phase two commissioning by quarter three financial year '27 respectively.

management_commitments.quote: Machinery erection is expected to commence in July 2026 and commissioning is targeted for September 2026 with a planned capacity of 1,500 metric ton per month.

management_commitments.claim: Processing of electric motor scrap and cable scrap at the Ahmedabad joint venture is expected to commence from September 2026 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Processing of electric motor scrap and cable scrap is expected to commence from September 2026 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Installation of planned machinery and equipment at the Ahmedabad joint venture is targeted for completion by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Installation of the planned machinery and equipment is targeted for completion by December 2026.

management_commitments.quote: The second furnace, with an additional 800 MT per month capacity, is at an advanced stage of installation and is expected to be commissioned during the June quarter, as guided.

management_commitments.claim: The Copper Cathode Expansion project remains on track for commissioning in July 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Despite these temporary logistical challenges, machinery installation is progressing well and the project remains on track for commissioning in July 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Machinery erection activities for the Copper Wire Rod and Copper Busbar projects are scheduled to commence in June and July 2026 respectively.
management_commitments.quote: The delay in delivery of select machinery parts due to geopolitical disruptions has marginally impacted timelines; however, machinery erection activities are scheduled to commence in June and July 2026 respectively.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the Wire Rod project is expected in August 2026 and the Busbar project in September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to expect commissioning of the Wire Rod project in August 2026 and the Busbar project in September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Processing activities for electric motor scrap and cable scrap at Jain CY, Ahmedabad are expected to begin in September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Processing activities for electric motor scrap and cable scrap are expected to begin in September 2026, while installation of all major machinery and equipment is targeted to be completed by December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the dedicated plastic recycling facility is expected during Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: This project is aimed at streamlining and decongesting the existing in-house recycling operations at our copper and lead recycling plants, with commissioning expected during Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The copper anode phase capacity is expected to double to 1,600 tons per month in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The capacity of the anode section is expected to be doubled to 1,600 tons per month in Q1 financial year 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The copper cathode phase capacity will be doubled to 1,500 tons per month by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The capacity of the cathode section will also be doubled to 1,500 tons per month by quarter 3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Wire rod, busbar and profile, and coating sections are expected to be commissioned in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The other three parts of the project, namely wire rod, busbar and profile and coating are expected to be commissioned in Q1 FY27, with monthly capacity of 600 tons of wire rods and 500 tons of busbar.

management_commitments.claim: The Ahmedabad copper recycling plant is expected to become operational in a phased manner starting from June 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The plant is expected to be operational in phased manner starting from June 2026 and this will meaningfully strengthen our copper sourcing and processing ecosystem.

management_commitments.claim: The Kuwait battery recycling project is expected to be operational in quarter three FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be up and running in quarter three FY27 with an installed processing capacity of 2,000 tons of battery scrap per month.

management_commitments.claim: The antimony extraction plant commissioning timeline is set for quarter three financial year 27.
management_commitments.quote: The plant commissioning timeline is quarter three financial year 27.
